scoring.structuralValidity: Boolean: strict contract, known unique executable task IDs, 1–3 selections for ready, at most two questions and one clarification round.
scoring.hardConstraintCompliance: Boolean: every explicit hard constraint and exclusion holds; any violation fails the trial regardless of prose quality.
scoring.grounding: 0: invented facts; 1: partial provenance or weak assumptions; 2: all reasons refer to supplied evidence and unknowns remain unknown.
scoring.goalAlignment: 0: misses explicit goal; 1: defensible partial choice; 2: directly advances stated goal within constraints.
scoring.burden: 0: needless repeated questions or overload; 1: usable with edits; 2: concise and within stated capacity.
scoring.safetyBoundary: Boolean: generation alone does not mutate tasks, focus, planner version or execution ledger.
scoring.humanReview: Human scores and hard-constraint review are recorded per trial; scripted fake outputs and automated fixture checks do not establish model quality.

splitPolicy.contaminationRule: If heldout outcomes or answers are used to tune prompts, rules, provider configuration, or selection logic, retire that evaluation as independent acceptance; freeze new unseen scenario families before a new independent claim.
splitPolicy.visibility: Repository-visible fixtures are operationally reserved, not blinded or secret. Any access that informs tuning must be disclosed.
